website.error: no public pipeline page found (403 on https://www.medline.com/pipeline; Medline is a medical supplies manufacturer/distributor and does not publish a clinical-pipeline page)

ctgov.note: All 9 Medline-sponsored interventional studies (chlorhexidine gluconate / CHG skin-prep cloth) are COMPLETED. The single RECRUITING study (PluroGel burn dressing, NCT05000983) is sponsored by University of Manitoba, with Medline as collaborator only.

commercial_product.summary: Medline is a privately-founded, recently-IPO'd manufacturer and distributor of medical-surgical supplies, durable medical equipment, and PPE. Marketed product families include CHG (chlorhexidine gluconate) skin-preparation cloths, PluroGel burn-wound matrix, exam/surgical gloves, gowns, drapes, custom procedure trays, and a broad commodity-supply catalog. None require an active drug-development pipeline.

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: COMPLETED 2014 — CHG cloth on healthy subjects

excluded_partner_owned.reason: PluroGel burn dressing — lead sponsor is University of Manitoba (investigator-initiated); Medline is collaborator only

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medline is a medical-surgical supply manufacturer/distributor; it has no proprietary drug or device development pipeline in active P1/P2/P3 trials. All company-sponsored interventional studies on file are completed CHG (chlorhexidine gluconate) skin-prep cloth studies for an already-marketed antiseptic product.
